review_kind: Separate AI question/answer check against the M4 source-checked lesson scopes; same assistant after authoring, not a separate human instructor or full-book recertification.

sample_gate.decision: Subject/predicate category/function distinctions, positive and negative diagram captions, original stems, source citations and scoring 0/5 through 5/5 reviewed before expanding the bank. Standing owner authorization applies; human instructor approval is not inferred.

scope: 120 variant items in 60 equivalent-example pools, using only the 12 M4 outcomes.
Each of 16 blueprints selects one of two variants from each of five distinct pools. Question and option orders are independently shuffled from a reproducible seed.
Structural diagnosis/repair grades a B-R diagram/convention, never free-form sentence grammaticality.
CLS-001 is grammatical classification only. Zero Cambridge runtime constraints were enabled.
Positive answer trees pass the approved canonical contract; incorrect candidates are deliberately labelled alternatives, not approved parses.
No book exercise wording or lesson prompt is reused as an independent quiz stem.
Negative feedback cites the same reviewed principle and describes why the selected alternative fails.
No inferred mastery from one short attempt; review and reinforcement map to source-linked lessons.
display_policy: Chapter 11 and Cambridge classification items are text-only.
Canonical AUX for infinitival to is displayed by its source feature, as in M4.
S-bar and S-dbar display S′ and S″.
not_claimed: New source review of all Cambridge extractions
High-stakes secure examination or full grammaticality coverage
